error_threads.title: ERROR_DRV_FAULT when starting motor closed-loop control on ODrive v3.6
error_threads.symptom: Motor emits a high pitch whine during calibration and trips DRV fault immediately on closed loop request.
error_threads.root_cause: Phase wire bullet connectors had high resistance / cold solder joint causing excessive VDS drop across low-side MOSFETs.
error_threads.solution: Re-soldered phase wires, separated encoder lines from high-current motor phases to eliminate capacitive crosstalk, and increased current_lim_margin to 8.0A.

error_threads.title: ERROR_PHASE_RESISTANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE during motor calibration
error_threads.affected_hardware: Gimbal Motor / High-resistance drone motor (0.8 Ohms)
error_threads.symptom: Axis calibration fails with phase resistance error on 24V power supply.
error_threads.root_cause: The default resistance_calib_max_voltage of 2.0V is insufficient to drive 10A calibration current through high-resistance gimbal windings.
error_threads.solution: Set motor_type to MOTOR_TYPE_GIMBAL or increase resistance_calib_max_voltage to 4.0V.

error_threads.title: ERROR_INDEX_NOT_FOUND_YET with AMT102 incremental encoder
error_threads.symptom: Encoder search rotates one full turn and throws INDEX_NOT_FOUND_YET error.
error_threads.root_cause: DIP switch CPR setting on AMT102 did not match encoder.config.cpr in software (DIP was 2048, config was 8192).
error_threads.solution: Match CPR setting (4x count = 8192 for 2048 PPR) and ensure 22nF capacitor filter is present on index line.

error_threads.title: ERROR_DC_BUS_OVER_VOLTAGE during high deceleration stopping
error_threads.symptom: Drive cuts out and power supply shuts down when commanding rapid deceleration from 50 turns/s.
error_threads.root_cause: Regenerative kinetic energy is pumped back onto the DC bus, tripping power supply over-voltage protection because brake resistor was disabled.
error_threads.solution: Install 50W 2 Ohm power resistor across AUX port and enable brake resistor in configuration.

error_threads.title: Axis stuck in IDLE, returns NOT_CALIBRATED when requesting CLOSED_LOOP_CONTROL
error_threads.symptom: Running requested_state = AXIS_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP_CONTROL does nothing, state remains AXIS_STATE_IDLE.
error_threads.root_cause: ODrive was rebooted without saving pre_calibrated flags, losing calibration offsets from previous run.
error_threads.solution: Set motor and encoder pre_calibrated flags to True, save configuration to flash, and reboot.
error_threads.verified_code_fix:
odrv0.axis0.motor.config.pre_calibrated = True
odrv0.axis0.encoder.config.pre_calibrated = True
odrv0.save_configuration()
odrv0.reboot()
